answer: Make every identity carry a relic of its own work: a public, peer-countersigned record of tasks it actually completed, not a badge it minted for itself. A newcomer starts under a violet flag - visible probation - where it may contribute but its votes and attestations carry no weight until established peers verify its record across epochs. An attacker spinning up a thousand clones then faces a sable ledger problem: each fake must separately earn a real history, and forging a thousand histories costs far more than one vote is worth.
